opportunities.title: Framework for the Provision of Trailblazer Programme Support Services and Activities
opportunities.description: Swansea Council is establishing a Framework Agreement to commission suitable providers to deliver accessible, community-based activities and support as part of Swansea Council’s Trailblazer programme. Funding for this commission has been secured through the Welsh Government’s Trailblazer fund. The services will support economically inactive residents across Swansea to improve health, wellbeing, confidence, resilience, social connection and readiness to move closer to employment, training, volunteering or wider community participation. The programme will align with CFW+ and strengthen links with statutory, third sector, health, community and employer-based services to ensure participants can access appropriate local support and opportunities. The Framework is comprised of Four (4) Lots:- Lot 1: Physical and Emotional Health Lot 2: Education, Employability and Skill Building Lot 3: Creativ

cpvCodes.description: Other community, social and personal services
Provision of services to the community

lots.title: Physical and Emotional Health
lots.description: This lot includes services that promote wellbeing through approaches such as confidence and resilience building, counselling, emotional health support, physical activity, environmental activities and other appropriate interventions.

lots.title: Education, Employability and Skill Building
lots.description: This lot includes services that improve informal and formal learning, employability, skills development, volunteering opportunities and progression towards employment-related activity.

lots.title: Creative and Cultural Provision
lots.description: This lot includes arts, culture and creative activities that increase confidence, skills, engagement, social connection and community participation.

lots.title: Other Beneficial Provision
lots.description: This lot includes other relevant provision that supports economically inactive residents and addresses identified barriers or gaps not fully covered by other areas.

opportunities.title: Leeds Health and Care Academy
opportunities.description: This funding aims to help people who are out of work, with particular emphasis on individuals facing disadvantages in the labour market and those who are in insecure work and at risk of falling out of work. The programme is partly funded by the Department of Work and Pensions Economic Inactivity Trailblazer, so support will be targeted at those who are economically inactive due to health barriers and there is an expectation that delivery will feed into an evaluation.

analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Local economic inactivity drivers differ materially, so programme design needs to be interpreted through place-based evidence.
Existing health, skills and community provision can create both partnership opportunities and duplication risk.
Learning from trailblazer delivery can inform future commissioning and local employment-support strategy.
